title: 'Mitochondrial Eve' paper
place: University of California, Berkeley, United States
summary: Cann, Stoneking and Wilson concluded in Nature that all living people's mitochondrial DNA traces back to one African population, dated then to about 200,000-140,000 years ago. Critics later challenged the methods.
why: Strong genetic support for a recent African origin of all living humans.

notes.problem: 'Showed' overstates; source gives it as the 'published conclusion' and says its methodology was soon criticised.
